stage0002_04:r_caaab7bad760e16d.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「The job we took is to cause a disturbance
　near that high school.」

stage0002_04:r_99b162aa6aa286a2.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「But watch it.
　Hurting the students is a no-go.
　Screw up and the boss has a nasty punishment ready.」

stage0002_04:r_58fb02434a1c40b2.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「...This is rough...
　Since the great 《$$ファイヤバグ$$》 got fired by the 《$$姫$$》,
　it's been nothing but drab little jobs like this...」

stage0002_04:r_1c0f94acd5a8a143.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「Quit complaining!
　Hurry up and do what we came for!」

stage0002_04:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$タクヤ$$
「W-what are those guys!?
　Do they plan to start a war in the middle of town!」

stage0002_04:r_3bc300bbdc277d82.text:
$$沙慈$$
「Run for it, $$タクヤ$$!
　The ones in those black Axios
　don't care about civilians at all!」

stage0002_04:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$沙慈$$
「$$バナージ$$!
　You stay with $$ミコット$$!」

stage0002_04:r_b05f6a6e8f3d9b24.text:
$$ミコット$$
「What is going on!
　If I'd known, I'd never have come on this exchange!」

stage0002_04:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$n
「So the one lurking on the hill behind us
　is with that group after all.」

stage0002_04:r_0abcaf0c31978670.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I DO NOT KNOW THEIR OBJECTIVE, BUT WOULD THEY
　NOT BE IDEAL OPPONENTS FOR THE GENION'S
　TEST, $n?」

stage0002_04:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「BE THAT AS IT MAY,
　THIS IS MY JOB...」

stage0002_04:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「NOW, NOW... THE GENION, AS I TAUGHT YOU YESTERDAY...!」

stage0002_04:r_9e701cdeb3842c21.text:
$n
「That thing calling itself $$ＡＧ$$...
　No doubt it's connected to the $$ジェニオン$$...」

stage0002_04:r_6fd81f4abebe60c5.text:
$$かなめ$$
「That blue robot is out there again!」

stage0002_04:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$スズネ$$
（$l...
　Are you the one riding inside it...?）

stage0002_04:r_495d61d3ec7e16f2.text:
$$正太郎$$
「After what happened yesterday I kept
　$$鉄人$$ and $$オックス$$ standing by nearby, but
　now even the robot mafia's remnants are here...!」

stage0002_04:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Blue robot, please lend us your help!
　Let's fight the ones attacking the city together!」

stage0002_04:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Give me a break...!
　Out again the very next day after yesterday!」

stage0002_04:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$宗介$$!
　I brought your M9 too, so get in already!」

stage0002_04:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$宗介$$
（But that man called $l and the small robot...
　Where on earth did they go...）

stage0002_04:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That AS I don't know is here again...」

stage0002_04:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$マオ$$
「No need to worry, kid.
　We came to crush them too.」

stage0002_04:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$マオ$$
「But watch yourself.
　I don't know what they're after, but
　the infamous 《$$ファイヤバグ$$》 is with them.」

stage0002_04:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Those perverted arsonist bastards,
　still crawling around alive.」

stage0002_04:r_708bea61e3c43ada.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right!
　I've fought them before!」

stage0002_04:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$正太郎$$
（Why is that...
　The moment I thought of $$ファイヤバグ$$, my head hurt...）

stage0002_04:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$正太郎$$
「No need to worry, $$オックス$$.
　I'm fine.」

stage0002_04:r_352534f64413d954.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Here we go, $$オックス$$, $$鉄人$$!
　We'll work with everyone and beat the bad guys!」

stage0002_04:r_a62c4e7f3c09f7ed.text:
$n
（$$ジェニオン$$...
　I'll master you, no matter what...!）

stage0002_04:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Keep this up and it's an easy win!」

stage0002_04:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$マオ$$
「Looks like you can't say that just yet!
　Reinforcements are coming!」

stage0002_04:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$マオ$$
「All units, heads up!
　Enemy reinforcements are coming!」

stage0002_04:r_b2befefdbed1393d.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Damn it!
　We've got our hands full with the ones here!」

stage0002_04:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$ファイヤバグ$$ Trooper
「To think even we, the reserves, get moved out...
　That's what comes of them resisting so much.」

stage0002_04:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$宗介$$
「They had a force this size in motion...!」

stage0002_04:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$マオ$$
「Tch...!
　At this rate the battlefield keeps spreading!」

stage0002_04:r_91bf33c27ad39f0a.text:
$$正太郎$$
「It's all right, everyone!
　Our reinforcements are here too!」

stage0002_04:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units will now defend the city from
　the enemy in joint operation with 《$$ミスリル$$》.」

stage0002_04:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「That's the name of that AS unit.」

stage0002_04:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$クラン$$
「The details can wait.
　Right now, beating them down comes first.」

stage0002_04:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「So what about that blue robot?」

stage0002_04:r_0ebc5a6f1e0f81bf.text:
$$ルカ$$
「Even the data $$ミスリル$$ gave us beforehand
　listed it as an Unknown...」

stage0002_04:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$アルト$$
「For now, it's not an enemy.
　Just leave it alone.」

stage0002_04:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$宗介$$
「Those people... they know of $$ミスリル$$?」

stage0002_04:r_9796b3efa401a303.text:
$$マオ$$
「Just got an emergency call from Major $$カリーニン$$.
　$$ミスリル$$'s taking a cooperative stance with them.」

stage0002_04:r_643b6eebfc0186b3.text:
$$マオ$$
「They're 《$$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$》, of the Frontier fleet...
　A private military provider, apparently.」

stage0002_04:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$宗介$$
「I've heard of them.
　They test the military's new units and study tactics.」

stage0002_04:r_32eb462c1b4999cb.text:
$$マオ$$
「The Frontier fleet's departure for the galactic
　core got postponed by the $$新世時空震動$$ mess.
　Well... lucky for us, as it turns out.」

stage0002_04:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$クルツ$$
「This $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ bunch...
　Both of us live in the shadows. We might get along.」

stage0002_04:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$マオ$$
「$$ウルズ$$ 6, 7!
　Let them look down on us before we've even met
　and we'll pay for it later. We can't lose here!」

stage0002_04:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$クラン$$
「They seem fired up over there.」

stage0002_04:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Then, acting Skull Leader... the command is yours.」

stage0002_04:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$アルト$$
「Skull 4 to all units!
　The civilians haven't finished evacuating.
　We intercept the enemy, fast!」

stage0002_04:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
???
「Not bad at all, $$ミスリル$$, $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$ and $$ＩＣＰＯ$$ alike.」

stage0002_04:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
???
「I surveyed their strength with throwaway pawns,
　but it seems I need a bit more data...」

stage0002_04:r_71ebf05996a4b0fd.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Well, that's settled for now, but...」

stage0002_04:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$宗介$$
「Whatever the machine's specs,
　the skill of its pilot is third-rate.」

stage0002_04:r_5b992878fee054b5.text:
$$マオ$$
「Sorry about this.
　I'd rather not rough up someone we fought beside...」

stage0002_04:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$マオ$$
「Capturing you happens to be part
　of our mission too.」

stage0002_04:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Whoa there, better not move.
　You try anything funny and I put a hole
　clean through that machine's thrusters.」

stage0002_04:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$クルツ$$
「And if that doesn't stop you,
　I'll shoot somewhere a lot nastier.」

stage0002_04:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「$$正太郎$$, I'd like to explain the situation
　and confirm a few things with you.
　Would you come aboard the Quarter?」

stage0002_04:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$キャシー$$
「We have $$ＩＣＰＯ$$'s consent through Director $$大塚$$.
　We ask for your cooperation.」

stage0002_04:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$正太郎$$
「But please promise me
　you won't treat him too roughly.」

stage0002_04:r_d1ec2522c87c361d.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「I swear we will do everything we can.」

stage0002_04:r_3599f0a4343fd95c.text:
$$マオ$$
「Well then, shall we let ourselves be invited
　to our new friends' hideout as well?」

stage0002_04:r_3bc7834a5bf3ee76.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「All units, withdraw immediately.
　We leave the cleanup to the Federation forces.」

stage0002_04:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$かなめ$$
「Yesterday and now this. What is going on!?」

stage0002_04:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$クルツ$$
「And that's about how it's done!」

stage0002_04:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$ルカ$$
「That person... seems to be a sniper, like $$ミシェル$$.」

stage0002_04:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Not bad at all...
　Reminds me of the first $$ロックオン$$...」

stage0002_04:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$クラン$$
「If joint operations with $$ミスリル$$ keep up,
　he looks set to become your rival.」

stage0002_04:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「The more skilled allies, the better.
　I hope that's what he'll be.」

stage0002_04:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That blue Valkyrie...
　Looks like a pretty capable sniper.」

stage0002_04:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$マオ$$
「That's a rare thing,
　you praising a sniper other than yourself.」

stage0002_04:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$クルツ$$
「That guy's skill might just be...
　on the level of Celestial Being's green Gundam...」

stage0002_04:r_1fe8564d2b959317.text:
$$クルツ$$
「Heh...! A rival shows up and I'm fired up!」

stage0002_04:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$n
（That man called Sagara...
　If he's unrelated to 《$$ＤＥＭ$$》, then who is he...）

stage0002_04:r_4b1247bd3ca4905d.text:
$n
（If he's making me his target,
　does that mean he's tied to 'him'...）

stage0002_04:r_00c55e25f87b71d0.text:
$n
「The pilot of this black machine... overwhelming!」

stage0002_04:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$n
「As I am now... I can't win...!」

stage0002_04:r_d91d4bc2d52b61c4.text:
$$正太郎$$
（What was that headache just now...?）

stage0002_04:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$正太郎$$
（Does it have something to do with $$ファイヤバグ$$...?）

stage0002_04:r_4dbfba00ba7744ee.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Branch's men!
　Branch is gone, and you still mean to do evil!」

stage0002_04:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$正太郎$$
「Then $$鉄人$$, $$オックス$$ and I will take you on!
　I won't go easy on bad guys!」

stage0002_04:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$宗介$$
（The boy in the seat next to $$千鳥かなめ$$...
　$F, I believe it was...）

stage0002_04:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$宗介$$
（The way he moved was that of a trained man...
　Just who is he...?）

stage0002_04:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$アルト$$
「The world finally found peace,
　and there are still guys who want to fight!」

stage0002_04:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$アルト$$
「Damn it...!
　Like I'd let a bunch who don't understand
　the value of peace have this city!」

stage0002_04:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Now then... I can't afford to lose
　to $$ミスリル$$'s sniper...」

stage0002_04:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$ミシェル$$
「Shall I introduce myself by showing off
　the skill of Skull Squadron's ace sniper...!」

stage0002_04:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$ルカ$$
「My machine's been fitted with a repair unit!
　If you've taken damage, let me know!」

stage0002_04:r_63249745ffae61b6.text:
$$クラン$$
「Nene, Raramia, take direct escort of the Quarter!」

stage0002_04:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$クラン$$
「I'm fine on my own!
　I'll show these war-hungry fools how a Zentran
　who found something greater than war fights!」

stage0002_04:r_3ff2e21207d1d1d3.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Our first real battle since the 《$$再世戦争$$》...
　All hands, are you ready?」

stage0002_04:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$キャシー$$
「The ship is at full combat readiness.」

stage0002_04:r_47ddabb7b60131c2.text:
$$モニカ$$
「Target checks are complete as well.」

stage0002_04:r_b025267f22788233.text:
$$ボビー$$
「Now then, $$ボス$$... a word, if you please.」

stage0002_04:r_ec1a06a7023bf72c.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Whether we wish it or not,
　there are those in this world who bring war to us...」

stage0002_04:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Then we make them pay the bill.
　Teach them the price of forgetting peace is high...!」
